items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Bobby Shad?' in a questioning tone, and the interviewer confirms 'Yeah. --', but the interviewee provides no further personal details, history, or description of a relationship with Bobby Shad.

ctx.x: Oh, I like it very much.

I think that's one of the best albums she ever made. You know, they left about three tracks off that album. She sang "...[SINGS]...and yet..." She sang that. And then we did... We played...just the two of us, we played. Well, I forget what that was. That wasn't on it. They didn't put that on it. Bobby Shad?
